_note: Register fragment for publication-relations-place-and-source-ids (REQ-PRS-001, REQ-PRS-003). Publications name how they relate to each other, readable from both sides through OpenRegister's relation vocabulary, and carry the identifiers their source systems know them by. The place (REQ-PRS-004) is gated on decision D10 and not declared here.

replaces.title: Replaces
replaces.description: The publications this one replaces. Each of them reads that it is replaced by this one.

amends.title: Amends
amends.description: The publications this one amends. Each of them reads that it is amended by this one.

implements.title: Implements
implements.description: The publications this one implements. Each of them reads that it is implemented by this one.

relatedTo.title: Related to
relatedTo.description: Publications that belong with this one. The relation reads the same from both sides.

sourceIdentifiers.title: Source identifiers
sourceIdentifiers.description: The identifiers the source systems know this publication by. An identifier is shown and searchable on the public API only when it is marked public.

system.title: System
system.description: The source system, such as case or decos.

identifier.title: Identifier
identifier.description: The identifier the source system uses.

public.title: Public
public.description: Whether the identifier may be shown and searched on the public API.
